Summary: Checks whether the customer-side and internal-side prerequisites for onboarding go-live are truly complete.
EntryCriteria: Configuration and handoff planning are largely complete and go-live is approaching.
ExitCriteria: No go-live-critical task is ownerless or hidden behind vague 'customer to confirm' language.
Checks: Customer-side access and ownership are explicit.
Configuration baseline is signed off or acknowledged.
Training or enablement artifacts are ready for affected users.
Support handoff and escalation path are documented.
